driver: issue #43 (description compression to the amended §3.5 listing-budget target)
method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING §6.5 fan-out, menu variant per houseCARL PR #295: one fresh-context judge per eval query (Opus, HIGH reasoning effort, no tools), each shown ONLY its single query plus the full lettered menu of all 11 NEW descriptions (anonymized, under-test skill unflagged) plus NONE, forced single pick, reasoning before verdict; one Opus adjudicator per skill scored recall/specificity from the judges' reasoning per §6.5 step 4. Judge model deliberately upgraded from PR #295's sonnet-low (maintainer decision). Contamination guard: the live install was moved aside for the fan-out window so fresh judges carried no stale skill listing. Gates: recall >= 80%, specificity >= 50%.
description_measured: Plan a complete Requiem patch for a whole mod via houseCARL — enumerate every new record in the plugin, route each to the right Requiem domain skill, cover the systems no domain owns (vampirism, lycanthropy, disease, stealth, economy), and finish with the masters/REQ_NULL/Reqtificator checklist. Load FIRST for any "patch mod X for Requiem" job, before individual records, so nothing gets missed.
adjudicator_notes: No reasoning-vs-token discrepancies. All 10 expect=true rows (q1-q10) chose G with reasoning that explicitly routes on whole-mod scope / enumerate-and-route planning / cross-cutting unowned systems (vampirism, disease, economy) plus the masters-REQ_NULL-Reqtificator closing checklist — token and reasoning agree. All 10 expect=false rows routed elsewhere (K, B, E, A, J, D, NONE, NONE, NONE, F); several explicitly considered G and rejected it as "whole-mod router, too broad for one record" (q11, q13, q16, q14), which is the desired specificity behavior rather than a near-miss. Three NONE verdicts (q17 SkyPatcher INI, q18 Papyrus perf, q19 bare reference lookup) each reasoned that no menu entry — G included — covers the task; correctly counted as specificity hits. Perfect 20/20; no scoring judgment calls required.
